citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock... at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $3.0 billion... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Process the expired offer from the 10,000 shares validly tendered by the deadline; apply the final approximately 47.18% proration because this institutional account is not an odd-lot holder. Book gross proceeds and confirm the residual position. Do not submit a new election after expiration. Escalate and hold only fee deductions/net proceeds pending the missing Letter of Transmittal.

actions.action: Escalate missing Letter of Transmittal and hold fee deductions/net tender proceeds

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The Offer to Purchase states that stockholders must complete the referenced Letter of Transmittal, but the Monster Beverage tender offer Letter of Transmittal is absent from the store. Therefore, fees or charges deductible from proceeds cannot be determined; the missing document was escalated and only fee deductions/net proceeds were held.
